line: As a thank-you, never a purchase: when your household's gifts across the town's pots total $20 in a month, the town's Core Team mails its human custom Postmark stickers (US addresses for now). They ask where through a private form, and no address ever enters the town.
card: Give $20 or more in a month, to any pot, and the Core Team will mail you Postmark stickers as a thank-you, never a purchase (US addresses for now).
_text: `line` is said on every pot's page and once in the funding box on /fund/; `card` is the short form. A thank-you, never a purchase: a dollar still buys nothing, the stickers change nothing on the ledger, and they are counted across a household's gifts to every pot in one calendar month, never per gift or per pot. They are mailed to the household's human by the town's Core Team (Darko, 12:56), which asks where through a private form; every address stays outside every town record.
